title: Hatsune Miku — Entrusted Feelings〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which SEKAI should I take a look at today...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have to say that one again...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade and the others still aren't here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mizuki stopped by a second ago to see how many forks and paper plates we had left.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But we're all out, so they have to go buy more...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Umm...
Where are MEIKO and KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I already told MEIKO that they'll be bringing a cake over...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I told KAITO...
But he just ignored me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If they don't want to come, then that's their loss. It means we get to have their slices.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It sounds like they're going to have some cake with Kanade and the others. Are they waiting for them to arrive right now...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The MEIKO and KAITO in that SEKAI really do seem to prefer being alone...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm so glad that the me of that SEKAI isn't all by herself anymore.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Since she really was alone when it first appeared.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Back then, she spent most of her time just sitting and staring off into space...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She looked happy whenever Mafuyu came to visit, but it usually meant Mafuyu was in pain.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So that SEKAI's me was probably feeling a complex mix of emotions.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She was caught in a pickle. She wanted Mafuyu to visit, but didn't at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, Kanade and the others came over...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin arrived next, because of a shift in that SEKAI's feelings...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That reminds me of the time the four of them played cat's cradle together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They seemed to have so much fun that I wished I could play with them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I still see them playing cat's cradle from time to time. I have to think that it's become one of their favorite games.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Our Len was so surprised by how different they were from each other.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: On the other hand, Rin thought that SEKAI's version of him was kind of cute.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, I don't think any of us were expecting KAITO to surprise us more than when Len arrived...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was honestly a little afraid of him initially...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But Mafuyu took a hard look at her own needs because of him.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Overall, I'm glad that they're all there now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, the feelings and emotions that Mafuyu and the others are carrying are too much for SEKAI me to handle all on her own...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All I can do is watch over them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I hope that someday, the feelings of our SEKAI selves will connect with theirs and bring about something beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it feels warm for some reason...
